# Sameet Sapra

> Personal website of Sameet Sapra, a software engineer based in Chicago.
> B.S. and M.C.S. in Computer Science (minor in Mathematical Statistics),
> University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Class of 2019.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.sameetsapra.com/): Introduction, selected writing,
  published work, and eating.
- [About](https://www.sameetsapra.com/about/): Background, current work,
  published work, and profiles.
- [Posts](https://www.sameetsapra.com/posts/): All posts, 2013–present.
- [Places](https://www.sameetsapra.com/places/): A world map of the cities
  where he has reviewed restaurants — 805 reviews across 77 cities, with a
  favorite and a top five in each, ranked from his Beli list and Google
  reviews. He is a Level 8 Google Maps Local Guide.
- [RSS](https://www.sameetsapra.com/rss.xml)

## Selected posts

- [I got hacked — here's my story and what I learned](https://www.sameetsapra.com/posts/i-got-hacked/)
  (2023): An iCloud account takeover and phone-number port-out — timeline
  and lessons.
- [Reflecting on my last year at UIUC](https://www.sameetsapra.com/posts/last-year-at-uiuc/)
  (2019): Graduate school, teaching, and a master's without research.
- [SOA Made Simple](https://www.sameetsapra.com/posts/soa-made-simple/)
  (2017): How ACM at UIUC rebuilt its web infrastructure (Project Groot)
  as microservices.
